svg.title: Inside the TMC9660
svg.desc: Block diagram of the TMC9660: its function blocks, how they connect and which package pins reach each block.
svg.text: Function blocks and their links, from the datasheet's block diagram (Functional Diagrams, p. 15). Pins on the edge carry their package number.
